```sql
WITH tabor_branch AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, a.date AS account_open_date
    FROM account a
    JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE d.district_name = 'Tabor'
),
owners AS (
    SELECT disp.account_id, c.gender, c.birth_number, c.client_id
    FROM disp
    JOIN client c ON disp.client_id = c.client_id
    WHERE disp.type = 'OWNER'
),
owner_ages AS (
    SELECT
        o.account_id,
        o.gender,
        -- extract YYYYMMDD from birth_number (format: YYMMDDxxxx),
        -- 3rd or 4th digit (from left) indicates gender, and add 50 to month for females
        -- Interpret the birth year for < 54 as 2000s, otherwise 1900s
        CASE
            WHEN SUBSTR(o.birth_number, 3, 2) > '50'
                THEN CAST(IFNULL('19' || SUBSTR(o.birth_number, 1, 2), 0) AS INTEGER)
            ELSE CAST(IFNULL('19' || SUBSTR(o.birth_number, 1, 2), 0) AS INTEGER)
        END AS birth_year,
        CASE
            -- For females: month = MM - 50 if MM > 50
            WHEN CAST(SUBSTR(o.birth_number, 3, 2) AS INTEGER) > 50
                THEN CAST(SUBSTR(o.birth_number, 3, 2) AS INTEGER) - 50
            ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(o.birth_number, 3, 2) AS INTEGER)
        END AS birth_month,
        CAST(SUBSTR(o.birth_number, 5, 2) AS INTEGER) AS birth_day
    FROM owners o
),
owner_final AS (
    SELECT account_id, gender,
    -- Calculate age at 1996-12-31
    CASE
        WHEN birth_month < 12 OR (birth_month = 12 AND birth_day <= 31)
            THEN 1996 - birth_year
        ELSE 1996 - birth_year - 1
    END AS age_on_1996_12_31
    FROM owner_ages
),
cards_ct AS (
    SELECT disp.account_id, COUNT(*) AS num_cards
    FROM card
    JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
    WHERE card.issued <= '1996-12-31'
    GROUP BY disp.account_id
),
loans AS (
    SELECT account_id, loan_id, status, date AS approved_date
    FROM loan
    WHERE date <= '1996-12-31'
),
loans_ct AS (
    SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS num_loans
    FROM loans
    GROUP BY account_id
),
loan_labels AS (
    SELECT
        tabor.account_id,
        CASE
            WHEN COUNT(loans.loan_id) = 0
                THEN 'no loan'
            WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN loans.status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
                THEN 'defaulted'
            WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN loans.status IN ('C','D') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
                THEN 'repaying'
            ELSE 'paid off'
        END AS loan_standing
    FROM tabor_branch tabor
    LEFT JOIN loans ON tabor.account_id = loans.account_id
    GROUP BY tabor.account_id
),
trans_97 AS (
    SELECT
        trans.account_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN trans.type = 'credit' THEN trans.amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_in,
        SUM(CASE WHEN trans.type IN ('debit', 'withdrawal') THEN trans.amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_out,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN trans.trans_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS num_transactions
    FROM trans
    WHERE trans.date >= '1997-01-01' AND trans.date <= '1997-12-31'
    GROUP BY trans.account_id
),
balances_97 AS (
    SELECT account_id,
           MAX(balance) AS peak_balance
    FROM (
        SELECT account_id, balance
        FROM trans
        WHERE date >= '1997-01-01' AND date <= '1997-12-31'
    )
    GROUP BY account_id
),
ranked_peaks AS (
    SELECT
        tabor.account_id,
        IFNULL(balances_97.peak_balance, 0) AS peak_balance,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY IFNULL(balances_97.peak_balance, 0) DESC, tabor.account_id ASC) AS peak_balance_rank
    FROM tabor_branch tabor
    LEFT JOIN balances_97 ON tabor.account_id = balances_97.account_id
)
SELECT
    tabor.account_id,
    tabor.account_open_date,
    owner_final.gender,
    owner_final.age_on_1996_12_31 AS owner_age_on_1996_12_31,
    IFNULL(cards_ct.num_cards, 0) AS num_cards_issued_by_1996,
    IFNULL(loans_ct.num_loans, 0) AS num_loans_approved_by_1996,
    loan_labels.loan_standing AS loan_standing_label,
    IFNULL(trans_97.num_transactions, 0) AS num_transactions_1997,
    IFNULL(trans_97.money_in, 0) AS total_money_in_1997,
    IFNULL(trans_97.money_out, 0) AS total_money_out_1997,
    ranked_peaks.peak_balance,
    ranked_peaks.peak_balance_rank
FROM tabor_branch tabor
JOIN owner_final ON tabor.account_id = owner_final.account_id
LEFT JOIN cards_ct ON tabor.account_id = cards_ct.account_id
LEFT JOIN loans_ct ON tabor.account_id = loans_ct.account_id
LEFT JOIN loan_labels ON tabor.account_id = loan_labels.account_id
LEFT JOIN trans_97 ON tabor.account_id = trans_97.account_id
LEFT JOIN ranked_peaks ON tabor.account_id = ranked_peaks.account_id
ORDER BY ranked_peaks.peak_balance_rank ASC, tabor.account_id ASC;
```

I'm preparing our branch's annual customer review. For every account held at the Tabor branch as of 31 December 1996, I need a one-row profile per account, ordered among tied ranks by ascending account id, showing: the account id; the date the account was opened; the owner's gender and their age at 31 December 1996 in whole completed years; the number of credit cards issued to the account by 31 December 1996 (0 if none); the number of loans approved to the account by 31 December 1996 (0 if none); a loan standing label; the number of transactions on the account during 1997; the total money into the account during 1997; the total money out of the account during 1997; the peak balance reached on the account during 1997 (0 if none); and the account's rank by 1997 peak balance, highest first, with ties sharing a rank and the next rank skipped (e.g. 1, 1, 3). All 'as of' figures are taken at 31 December 1996; activity figures cover the calendar year 1997. A card or loan counts as held if it was issued or approved on or before 31 December 1996. The loan standing label is: 'no loan' if the account had no loans approved by 31 December 1996; otherwise 'defaulted' if any of its loans has repayment status B; otherwise 'repaying' if any has status C or D; otherwise 'paid off'. Money in is the sum of credit transaction amounts; money out is the sum of debit and cash-withdrawal transaction amounts. The account owner is the person with the 'OWNER' disposition on the account; other dispositions are just additional users. Nothing beyond these fields, please.

WITH classic_card_clients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT disp.client_id, disp.account_id, account.district_id
    FROM disp
    JOIN card ON disp.disp_id = card.disp_id
    JOIN account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id
    WHERE disp.type = 'OWNER' AND card.type = 'classic'
),
external_outgoing AS (
    SELECT 
        ccc.account_id,
        ccc.district_id,
        trans.amount,
        trans.bank
    FROM classic_card_clients ccc
    JOIN trans ON ccc.account_id = trans.account_id
    WHERE trans.type = 'debit' AND trans.bank IS NOT NULL AND trans.bank != ''
),
district_base AS (
    SELECT district_id, A2 AS district_name FROM district
)
SELECT
    db.district_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ccc.client_id) AS num_classic_card_clients,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN eo.bank IS NOT NULL THEN eo.account_id || '-' || eo.bank END) AS num_external_accounts_paid,
    COALESCE(SUM(eo.amount), 0) AS total_outgoing_amount
FROM district_base db
LEFT JOIN account a ON db.district_id = a.district_id
LEFT JOIN classic_card_clients ccc ON a.account_id = ccc.account_id
LEFT JOIN external_outgoing eo ON eo.account_id = a.account_id
GROUP BY db.district_id, db.district_name
ORDER BY total_outgoing_amount DESC, db.district_name ASC

first_request.user:
I'd like a district-by-district picture of where our classic-card-holding account owners send money outside the bank. For every district, give me: the district name, the number of clients who own an account and hold a classic credit card, the number of external accounts at other banks those clients paid through outgoing payments, and the total amount of those outgoing payments. A district means the district of the branch where the owned account is held — not the client's home district — and each client and every outgoing payment from the account they own counts toward that account's branch district. Include every district, even ones with no such clients or no such outgoing payments (show zeros). Use the whole recorded payment history. Order by total amount paid from highest to lowest, and alphabetically by district name when totals tie. Don't round the totals.

No follow-up user is available. Give the best supported answer for the question. Return your final answer as exactly one fenced SQL block containing a single read-only SQLite SELECT/WITH query. Exclude intermediate SQL.

calls.content:
```sql
WITH classic_clients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id, acc.district_id, disp.client_id
    FROM disp d
    JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
    JOIN account acc ON d.account_id = acc.account_id
    WHERE c.type = 'classic' AND d.type = 'OWNER'
),
districts AS (
    SELECT district_id, A2.district_name
    FROM district A2
),
ext_payments AS (
    SELECT 
        cc.account_id, 
        t.amount,
        t.k_symbol,
        t.bank
    FROM classic_clients cc
    JOIN trans t ON cc.account_id = t.account_id
    WHERE t.type = 'debit' 
        AND t.k_symbol = 'payment'
        AND t.bank IS NOT NULL AND t.bank != ''
)
SELECT
    d.district_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cc.client_id) AS num_classic_clients,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ep.bank IS NOT NULL THEN ep.bank || '-' || ep.account_id || '-' || ep.amount || '-' || ep.k_symbol END) AS num_external_payments,
    IFNULL(SUM(ep.amount),0) AS total_outgoing_amount
FROM
    districts d
LEFT JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id
LEFT JOIN disp disp2 ON a.account_id = disp2.account_id AND disp2.type = 'OWNER'
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id, acc.district_id, disp.client_id
    FROM disp d
    JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
    JOIN account acc ON d.account_id = acc.account_id
    WHERE c.type = 'classic' AND d.type = 'OWNER'
) cc ON a.account_id = cc.account_id AND a.district_id = cc.district_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        cc.account_id, 
        t.amount,
        t.k_symbol,
        t.bank
    FROM classic_clients cc
    JOIN trans t ON cc.account_id = t.account_id
    WHERE t.type = 'debit' 
        AND t.k_symbol = 'payment'
        AND t.bank IS NOT NULL AND t.bank != ''
) ep ON cc.account_id = ep.account_id
GROUP BY
    d.district_id, d.district_name
ORDER BY
    total_outgoing_amount DESC,
    d.district_name ASC
;
```

sql:
WITH lucas_2010_qual AS (
  SELECT q.raceId, q.position AS lucas_position
  FROM qualifying q
  JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId
  JOIN races r ON q.raceId = r.raceId
  WHERE d.surname = 'di Grassi' AND r.year = 2010 AND q.position IS NOT NULL
),
other_qual_2010 AS (
  SELECT q.raceId, q.driverId, q.position
  FROM qualifying q
  JOIN races r ON q.raceId = r.raceId
  WHERE r.year = 2010 AND q.position IS NOT NULL
),
outqualified AS (
  SELECT o.driverId
  FROM lucas_2010_qual l
  JOIN other_qual_2010 o ON l.raceId = o.raceId
  WHERE o.position > l.lucas_position -- means Lucas qualified ahead
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT outqualified.driverId) AS drivers_outqualified
FROM outqualified
LIMIT 100

WITH longest_pitstops AS (
  SELECT
    ps.raceId,
    ps.driverId,
    ps.stop,
    ps.milliseconds,
    r.circuitId
  FROM pitStops ps
  JOIN (
    SELECT MAX(milliseconds) AS max_ms
    FROM pitStops
  ) mx
  ON ps.milliseconds = mx.max_ms
  JOIN races r ON ps.raceId = r.raceId
),
race_circuit_details AS (
  SELECT
    lp.milliseconds,
    r.year,
    c.name AS circuit_name,
    c.location,
    c.country
  FROM longest_pitstops lp
  JOIN races r ON lp.raceId = r.raceId
  JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
)
SELECT
  circuit_name,
  location,
  country,
  year AS season_year,
  milliseconds AS pit_stop_length_ms
FROM race_circuit_details
ORDER BY season_year, circuit_name

WITH shared_first_names AS (
    SELECT forename
    FROM drivers
    GROUP BY forename
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
),
drivers_no_code_shared_name AS (
    SELECT driverId
    FROM drivers
    WHERE code IS NULL
      AND forename IN (SELECT forename FROM shared_first_names)
),
qualifying_under_2min AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM qualifying
    WHERE q1 IS NOT NULL
      AND (
        CAST(substr(q1, 1, instr(q1, ':')-1) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
        CAST(substr(q1, instr(q1, ':')+1) AS FLOAT)
      ) < 120
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS qualifying_1_under_2min_count
FROM qualifying_under_2min
WHERE driverId IN (SELECT driverId FROM drivers_no_code_shared_name);

sql:
WITH french_gp_races AS (
  SELECT
    r.raceId,
    r.date
  FROM races r
  JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
  WHERE c.name LIKE '%France%' AND r.year >= 1990
),
fastest_laps AS (
  SELECT
    lt.raceId,
    lt.driverId,
    MIN(lt.milliseconds/1000.0) AS best_lap_seconds
  FROM lapTimes lt
  WHERE lt.raceId IN (SELECT raceId FROM french_gp_races)
  GROUP BY lt.raceId, lt.driverId
),
slower_than_90 AS (
  SELECT
    fl.raceId,
    fl.driverId,
    fl.best_lap_seconds
  FROM fastest_laps fl
  WHERE fl.best_lap_seconds > 90
),
drivers_info AS (
  SELECT
    d.driverId,
    d.forename,
    d.surname
  FROM drivers d
)
SELECT
  r.date,
  d.forename,
  d.surname,
  CASE
    WHEN s.best_lap_seconds IS NOT NULL THEN
      printf('%d:%06.3f',
        CAST(s.best_lap_seconds/60 AS INTEGER),
        CAST(s.best_lap_seconds - 60 * CAST(s.best_lap_seconds/60 AS INTEGER) AS REAL)
      )
    ELSE NULL
  END AS fastest_lap_time
FROM french_gp_races r
LEFT JOIN slower_than_90 s ON r.raceId = s.raceId
LEFT JOIN drivers_info d ON s.driverId = d.driverId
ORDER BY r.date ASC, d.surname ASC, d.forename ASC

sql:
WITH australian_drivers AS (
    SELECT driverId
    FROM drivers
    WHERE nationality = 'Australian'
),
target_seasons AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT s.year
    FROM seasons s
    JOIN races r ON s.year = r.year
    JOIN driverStandings ds ON r.raceId = ds.raceId
    WHERE s.year BETWEEN 2002 AND 2013
      AND ds.driverId IN (SELECT driverId FROM australian_drivers)
      AND ds.position < 21
),
qualifying_races AS (
    SELECT r.raceId, r.year
    FROM races r
    WHERE r.year IN (SELECT year FROM target_seasons)
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM driverStandings ds
          WHERE ds.raceId = r.raceId
            AND ds.driverId IN (SELECT driverId FROM australian_drivers)
            AND ds.position < 21
      )
),
count_pitstops AS (
    SELECT qr.year, COUNT(*) AS total_pit_stops
    FROM pitStops ps
    JOIN qualifying_races qr ON ps.raceId = qr.raceId
    GROUP BY qr.year
)
SELECT s.year, IFNULL(cps.total_pit_stops, 0) AS total_pit_stops
FROM seasons s
LEFT JOIN count_pitstops cps ON s.year = cps.year
WHERE s.year BETWEEN 2002 AND 2013
ORDER BY s.year;

WITH driver_wins AS (
    SELECT 
        d.driverId,
        d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS full_name,
        d.nationality,
        d.dob AS dateOfBirth,
        r.raceId,
        r.name AS race_name,
        r.date AS race_date
    FROM results res
    JOIN drivers d ON res.driverId = d.driverId
    JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
    WHERE res.positionOrder = 1
),
oldest_winner AS (
    SELECT 
        driverId,
        full_name,
        nationality,
        dateOfBirth
    FROM driver_wins
    ORDER BY dateOfBirth ASC, full_name ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
first_win AS (
    SELECT 
        dw.driverId,
        dw.race_name,
        dw.race_date
    FROM driver_wins dw
    JOIN oldest_winner ow ON dw.driverId = ow.driverId
    ORDER BY dw.race_date ASC, dw.race_name ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
race_count AS (
    SELECT 
        res.driverId, 
        COUNT(DISTINCT res.raceId) AS total_races_started
    FROM results res
    GROUP BY res.driverId
)
SELECT
    ow.full_name,
    ow.nationality,
    fw.race_name AS first_win_race,
    fw.race_date AS first_win_date,
    rc.total_races_started
FROM oldest_winner ow
JOIN first_win fw ON ow.driverId = fw.driverId
JOIN race_count rc ON ow.driverId = rc.driverId
LIMIT 1;

sql:
WITH italian_gp_2017 AS (
  SELECT ra.raceId
  FROM races ra
  JOIN circuits ci ON ra.circuitId = ci.circuitId
  WHERE ra.year = 2017 AND (ra.name = 'Italian Grand Prix' OR ci.name LIKE '%Monza%')
),
q2_times AS (
  SELECT
    q.driverId,
    q.constructorId,
    q.q2,
    r.grid
  FROM qualifying q
  JOIN italian_gp_2017 i ON q.raceId = i.raceId
  JOIN results r ON q.raceId = r.raceId AND q.driverId = r.driverId
  WHERE q.q2 IS NOT NULL
),
ranked_q2 AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      ORDER BY 
        CASE WHEN instr(q2, ':') > 0 THEN 
          CAST(substr(q2, 1, instr(q2, ':')-1) AS INTEGER)*60 + 
          CAST(substr(q2, instr(q2, ':')+1) AS FLOAT)
        ELSE 
          CAST(q2 AS FLOAT)
        END ASC,
        grid ASC
    ) AS rk
  FROM q2_times
)
SELECT d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name
FROM ranked_q2
JOIN drivers d ON ranked_q2.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN constructors c ON ranked_q2.constructorId = c.constructorId
WHERE rk = 2
LIMIT 1;

For the 2017 Italian Grand Prix, which driver set the second-fastest time in the second qualifying session (Q2), and which constructor did he drive for that weekend? By second-fastest I mean the driver whose Q2 time comes next after the quickest one, counting every driver who took part in that session. If two drivers tie on Q2 time, the one who started the race higher up the grid counts as the faster of the two. Please give me the driver's forename, the driver's surname, and the constructor name.

No follow-up user is available. Give the best supported answer for the question. Return your final answer as exactly one fenced SQL block containing a single read-only SQLite SELECT/WITH query. Exclude intermediate SQL.

calls.content:
```sql
WITH italian_gp_2017 AS (
  SELECT ra.raceId
  FROM races ra
  JOIN circuits ci ON ra.circuitId = ci.circuitId
  WHERE ra.year = 2017 AND (ra.name = 'Italian Grand Prix' OR ci.name LIKE '%Monza%')
),
q2_times AS (
  SELECT
    q.driverId,
    q.constructorId,
    q.q2,
    r.grid
  FROM qualifying q
  JOIN italian_gp_2017 i ON q.raceId = i.raceId
  JOIN results r ON q.raceId = r.raceId AND q.driverId = r.driverId
  WHERE q.q2 IS NOT NULL
),
ranked_q2 AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      ORDER BY 
        CASE WHEN instr(q2, ':') > 0 THEN 
          CAST(substr(q2, 1, instr(q2, ':')-1) AS INTEGER)*60 + 
          CAST(substr(q2, instr(q2, ':')+1) AS FLOAT)
        ELSE 
          CAST(q2 AS FLOAT)
        END ASC,
        grid ASC
    ) AS rk
  FROM q2_times
)
SELECT d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name
FROM ranked_q2
JOIN drivers d ON ranked_q2.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN constructors c ON ranked_q2.constructorId = c.constructorId
WHERE rk = 2
LIMIT 1;
```

  FROM races r
  JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
  WHERE c.name LIKE '%Shanghai%' AND r.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2009
),

  -- Shanghai, China local time is UTC+8
  SELECT
    *,
    datetime(date || ' ' || COALESCE(time, '14:00:00'), '+8 hours') AS local_start
  FROM china_2000s
),

  WHERE local_start = (

      FROM with_local_datetime
      WHERE local_start = (

        FROM with_local_datetime
      )
    )
  )
  -- If several have same earliest, use most recent year (max)
  AND year = (SELECT MAX(year) FROM with_local_datetime WHERE local_start = (SELECT MIN(local_start) FROM with_local_datetime))
),

  SELECT

  JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
  JOIN drivers d ON res.driverId = d.driverId
),

```sql
  SELECT time AS winner_time
  FROM china_results
  WHERE positionOrder = 1
),
runnerup_gap AS (
  SELECT
    (SELECT year FROM earliest_local) AS season_year,
    CASE
      WHEN cr.time IS NOT NULL AND (SUBSTR(cr.time, 1, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9') -- if it's a gap like '+10.123'

    END AS runnerup_gap_to_winner
  FROM china_results cr
  WHERE positionOrder = 2
)
SELECT season_year, runnerup_gap_to_winner
FROM runnerup_gap;
```

WITH race_times AS (
  SELECT
    races.raceId,
    races.circuitId,
    races.year,
    races.date,
    races.time,
    datetime(races.date || 'T' || COALESCE(races.time, '00:00:00')) as start_datetime
  FROM races
)
, min_max_times AS (
  SELECT
    MIN(start_datetime) AS earliest_time,
    MAX(start_datetime) AS latest_time
  FROM race_times
)
, circuits_map AS (
  SELECT circuitId, circuitRef FROM circuits
)
SELECT
  'earliest' AS category,
  c.circuitRef,
  r.start_datetime AS start_time
FROM race_times r
JOIN min_max_times m ON r.start_datetime = m.earliest_time
JOIN circuits_map c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'latest' AS category,
  c.circuitRef,
  r.start_datetime AS start_time
FROM race_times r
JOIN min_max_times m ON r.start_datetime = m.latest_time
JOIN circuits_map c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'gap_seconds' AS category,
  NULL AS circuitRef,
  CAST((strftime('%s', m.latest_time) - strftime('%s', m.earliest_time)) AS TEXT) AS gap_in_seconds
FROM min_max_times m;

WITH drivers_1980s AS (
    SELECT
        driverId,
        forename,
        surname,
        dob
    FROM
        drivers
    WHERE
        dob >= '1980-01-01'
        AND dob < '1990-01-01'
),
fastest_laps AS (
    SELECT
        lt.driverId,
        MIN(lt.milliseconds) AS best_lap_time
    FROM
        lapTimes lt
        JOIN drivers_1980s d ON lt.driverId = d.driverId
    WHERE
        lt.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY
        lt.driverId
)
SELECT
    d.forename,
    d.surname
FROM
    fastest_laps fl
    JOIN drivers_1980s d ON fl.driverId = d.driverId
ORDER BY
    fl.best_lap_time ASC,
    d.dob ASC,
    d.surname ASC
LIMIT 3;

WITH fall_events AS (
  SELECT event_id, event_name
  FROM event
  WHERE event_date >= '2019-09-01' AND event_date <= '2019-11-30'
),
event_attendance AS (
  SELECT 
    e.event_id,
    e.event_name,
    COUNT(a.link_to_member) AS student_count
  FROM fall_events e
  LEFT JOIN attendance a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
  GROUP BY e.event_id
),
soccer_attendance AS (
  SELECT student_count
  FROM event_attendance
  WHERE LOWER(event_name) LIKE '%women%' AND LOWER(event_name) LIKE '%soccer%'
  LIMIT 1
),
avg_attendance AS (
  SELECT ROUND(AVG(student_count*1.0), 1) AS avg_students
  FROM event_attendance
)
SELECT
  (SELECT student_count FROM soccer_attendance) AS womens_soccer_attendance,
  (SELECT avg_students FROM avg_attendance) AS avg_attendance_fall2019,
  CASE
    WHEN (SELECT student_count FROM soccer_attendance) > (SELECT avg_students FROM avg_attendance) THEN 'more'
    WHEN (SELECT student_count FROM soccer_attendance) < (SELECT avg_students FROM avg_attendance) THEN 'fewer'
    ELSE 'equal'
  END AS verdict
;

WITH college_majors AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        m.department,
        m.major_name
    FROM major m
    WHERE m.college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences'
),
departments_in_college AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT department
    FROM college_majors
),
majors_with_members AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        m.major_name
    FROM member mb
    JOIN major m ON mb.link_to_major = m.major_id
    WHERE m.college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences'
),
department_major_members AS (
    SELECT
        m.department,
        m.major_name,
        COUNT(mb.member_id) AS member_count
    FROM major m
    LEFT JOIN member mb ON mb.link_to_major = m.major_id
    WHERE m.college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences'
    GROUP BY m.department, m.major_name
)
SELECT
    d.department,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT cm.major_name) AS offered_majors,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN mwm.major_name IS NOT NULL THEN mwm.major_name END) AS held_majors,
    ROUND(AVG(dmm.member_count * 1.0), 2) AS avg_members_per_major
FROM departments_in_college d
LEFT JOIN college_majors cm ON d.department = cm.department
LEFT JOIN majors_with_members mwm 
    ON cm.major_name = mwm.major_name
LEFT JOIN department_major_members dmm 
    ON d.department = dmm.department AND cm.major_name = dmm.major_name
GROUP BY d.department
ORDER BY d.department
LIMIT 1000

  SELECT DISTINCT mbd.member_id, mbd.department
  FROM members_by_dept mbd

JOIN max_count mx ON mc.attendee_count = mx.max_attendance
ORDER BY mc.major_name ASC

I'm finalizing the semester wrap-up report and need one number: how many different kinds of things the club bought for events that went over budget this semester. A few things to keep in mind: an event counts as over budget if, in at least one of its budgeted categories, we spent more than we budgeted for that category - the budgeted amount minus what was actually spent came out below zero. Also, a single purchase can cover several kinds of things at once, and the purchase description lists what it bought, so make sure each kind is counted. The answer should cover the whole semester shown in the records, and I just need the single integer count, nothing else.

No follow-up user is available. Give the best supported answer for the question. Return your final answer as exactly one fenced SQL block containing a single read-only SQLite SELECT/WITH query. Exclude intermediate SQL.

calls.content:
```sql
WITH semester_events AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT e.event_id
  FROM event e
  JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.event_id
  JOIN expense ex ON e.event_id = ex.event_id AND b.category = ex.category
  WHERE (b.amount - ex.amount) < 0
),
event_expenses AS (
  SELECT ex.expense_id, ex.description
  FROM expense ex
  WHERE ex.event_id IN (SELECT event_id FROM semester_events)
),
kinds AS (
  -- Assume purchase description uses commas or 'and' to delimit items. 
  -- Split descriptions on comma or ' and ' as a basic double-pass.
  SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(LOWER(value)) AS kind
  FROM (
    SELECT
      CASE
        WHEN instr(description, ',') > 0 THEN description
        ELSE REPLACE(description, ' and ', ',')
      END AS desc_commas
    FROM event_expenses
  ),
  -- split desc_commas on comma
  LATERAL (
    SELECT substr(
      desc_commas,
      start + 1,
      end - start - 1
    ) AS value
    FROM (
      SELECT
        0 AS start,
        instr(desc_commas || ',', ',') AS end
      UNION ALL
      SELECT
        instr(desc_commas || ',', ',', prev_end + 1),
        instr(desc_commas || ',', ',', instr(desc_commas || ',', ',', prev_end + 1) + 1)
      FROM (
        SELECT
          instr(desc_commas || ',', ',', 1) AS prev_end
      )
      WHERE prev_end > 0 AND prev_end < length(desc_commas)
    )
    WHERE end > start
  )
  WHERE value IS NOT NULL AND value <> ''
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT kind) AS kind_count FROM kinds;
```

sql:
WITH oct_nov_expenses AS (
    SELECT
        e.link_to_member AS member_id,
        m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name AS full_name,
        e.expense_description AS item_kind,
        e.cost
    FROM
        expense e
        JOIN member m ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
    WHERE
        strftime('%Y-%m', e.expense_date) IN ('2019-10', '2019-11')
),
member_item_counts AS (
    SELECT
        member_id,
        full_name,
        COUNT(DISTINCT item_kind) AS kinds_count,
        SUM(cost) AS total_spending
    FROM
        oct_nov_expenses
    GROUP BY
        member_id, full_name
),
max_kinds AS (
    SELECT MAX(kinds_count) AS max_kinds_count FROM member_item_counts
)
SELECT
    mic.full_name,
    mic.kinds_count,
    mic.total_spending
FROM
    member_item_counts mic
    JOIN max_kinds mk ON mic.kinds_count = mk.max_kinds_count
LIMIT 100

  hero_powers_count

GROUP BY

WITH ranked_heroes AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY height_cm DESC) AS rnk
  FROM superhero
),
top_heroes AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM ranked_heroes
  WHERE rnk <= (
    SELECT rnk FROM (
      SELECT DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY height_cm DESC) AS rnk
      FROM superhero
      ORDER BY height_cm DESC
      LIMIT 1 OFFSET 9
    )
  )
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT hero_power.power_id) AS distinct_superpowers
FROM hero_power
JOIN top_heroes ON hero_power.hero_id = top_heroes.id;

WITH blackwulf_publisher AS (
  SELECT publisher_id
  FROM superhero
  WHERE superhero_name = 'Blackwulf'
  LIMIT 1
),
target_eyes AS (
  -- Eye colours among Blackwulf's publisher's heroes that also appear for some hero of a different publisher (excluding publisher_id is null)
  SELECT DISTINCT s1.eye_colour_id
  FROM superhero s1
  JOIN blackwulf_publisher bp ON s1.publisher_id = bp.publisher_id
  WHERE s1.eye_colour_id IS NOT NULL
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM superhero s2
      WHERE s2.eye_colour_id = s1.eye_colour_id
        AND s2.publisher_id IS NOT NULL
        AND s2.publisher_id != bp.publisher_id
    )
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) AS hero_count
FROM superhero s
JOIN blackwulf_publisher bp ON s.publisher_id = bp.publisher_id
JOIN target_eyes te ON s.eye_colour_id = te.eye_colour_id
WHERE s.eye_colour_id IS NOT NULL;

  GROUP BY h.id
)
SELECT MAX(power_count) as max_power_count_among_lightest

```sql
WITH max_anti_rnp AS (
  SELECT
    l.*
  FROM Laboratory l
  WHERE l."anti-ribonuclear protein" = (SELECT MAX("anti-ribonuclear protein") FROM Laboratory)
),
max_total_bilirubin AS (

FROM max_anti_rnp l
JOIN Patient p ON l.patient_id = p.patient_id
WHERE l."total bilirubin" = (SELECT max_tb FROM max_total_bilirubin)
```

WITH female_inpatients AS (
  SELECT ID
  FROM Patient
  WHERE SEX = 'F'
    AND Admission = 'Inpatient'
),
max_dna_per_patient AS (
  SELECT l.ID AS patient_id, MAX(CAST(l.DNA AS REAL)) AS max_dna
  FROM Laboratory l
  JOIN female_inpatients f ON l.ID = f.ID
  WHERE l.DNA IS NOT NULL AND l.DNA != ''
  GROUP BY l.ID
)
SELECT l.ID AS patient_id, l.Date AS lab_test_date, l.DNA AS anti_DNA_antibody_level
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN max_dna_per_patient m
 ON l.ID = m.patient_id
 AND CAST(l.DNA AS REAL) = m.max_dna
ORDER BY l.ID;

Among the female patients who were admitted to the hospital as inpatients, I need to find the laboratory test record with the highest anti-DNA antibody level, for a case review. Please give me the patient ID, the laboratory test date of that record, and the anti-DNA antibody level reported in it - nothing else. Order the results by patient ID, and if several lab test records share the highest level, list each of them.

No follow-up user is available. Give the best supported answer for the question. Return your final answer as exactly one fenced SQL block containing a single read-only SQLite SELECT/WITH query. Exclude intermediate SQL.

calls.content:
```sql
WITH female_inpatients AS (
  SELECT PatientID
  FROM Patient
  WHERE Gender = 'Female'
    AND AdmissionType = 'Inpatient'
),
max_anti_dna_by_patient AS (
  SELECT
    L.PatientID,
    MAX(L.AntiDNAAntibody) AS max_anti_dna
  FROM Laboratory L
  JOIN female_inpatients F ON L.PatientID = F.PatientID
  WHERE L.AntiDNAAntibody IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY L.PatientID
)
SELECT
  L.PatientID,
  L.LabTestDate,
  L.AntiDNAAntibody
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN max_anti_dna_by_patient M
  ON L.PatientID = M.PatientID
 AND L.AntiDNAAntibody = M.max_anti_dna
ORDER BY L.PatientID;
```

```sql
WITH registry_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT PatientID
  FROM Patient
  WHERE Registry = 'thrombosis'
    AND FollowUpType = 'outpatient'
),
abnormal_hematocrit AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT PatientID
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE TestName = 'hematocrit'
    AND (ResultValue < LowerNormalRange OR ResultValue > UpperNormalRange)
```

  JOIN (

    GROUP BY "ID"

    -- Only two diagnoses for each patient and must match required two (in either order)
    (
      (diag.diagnoses = 'rheumatoid arthritis,Sjögren''s syndrome')
      OR
      (diag.diagnoses = 'Sjögren''s syndrome,rheumatoid arthritis')
      OR
      (diag.diagnoses = 'rheumatoid arthritis|Sjögren''s syndrome')
      OR
      (diag.diagnoses = 'Sjögren''s syndrome|rheumatoid arthritis')
    )
),
lab_norm AS (
  SELECT l.ID AS patient_id,
         MAX(CASE
             WHEN PLT IS NOT NULL AND PLT BETWEEN 150000 AND 450000 THEN 1
             ELSE 0 END) AS has_normal
    -- Assuming normal platelet count 150000-450000 /uL as standard reference.
  FROM Laboratory l
  GROUP BY l.ID
)

  SUM(CASE WHEN lab_norm.has_normal = 0 OR lab_norm.has_normal IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS patients_without_normal_platelet

I'm writing a report section on abnormal total protein in female SLE patients and need one summary figure. Among the laboratory records of female patients diagnosed with systemic lupus erythematosus at an examination visit, where total protein is above the normal bound of 8.5, what is the average deviation of total protein from that bound across all qualifying records, rounded to three decimal places? A few points: an examination visit counts as an SLE diagnosis when systemic lupus erythematosus is among the diseases that visit's diagnosis lists, whether it's the only one or appears alongside others; the normal bound is 8.5, and a record counts as above the bound only when its TP is greater than 8.5; a record's deviation is its TP minus 8.5; and the average should cover all qualifying laboratory records across all dates.

```sql
WITH sle_female_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p.PatientID
  FROM Patient p
  JOIN Examination e ON p.PatientID = e.PatientID
  WHERE p.Gender = 'Female'
    AND (
      ',' || e.DiagnosisList || ',' LIKE '%,systemic lupus erythematosus,%'
      OR e.DiagnosisList = 'systemic lupus erythematosus'
    )
),
sle_exam_visits AS (
  SELECT e.ExamID
  FROM Examination e
  JOIN sle_female_patients p ON e.PatientID = p.PatientID

    AND l.TotalProtein > 8.5
)

FROM tp_records_above_bound;
```

WITH thrombosis_female_patients AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Patient
    WHERE SEX = 'F' AND Diagnosis LIKE '%thrombosis%'
),
rnp_results AS (
    SELECT ID, RNP
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE RNP IS NOT NULL
),
eligible_patients AS (
    SELECT l.ID, l.RNP
    FROM rnp_results l
    INNER JOIN thrombosis_female_patients p ON l.ID = p.ID
),
parsed_results AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        RNP,
        CASE
            WHEN RNP LIKE '1:%' THEN CAST(SUBSTR(RNP, 3) AS INTEGER)
            ELSE NULL
        END AS titer_value
    FROM eligible_patients
    WHERE RNP NOT IN ('negative', 'Negative', 'NEGATIVE')
),
all_tested AS (
    SELECT ID FROM eligible_patients
),
elevated AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM parsed_results
    WHERE titer_value > 64
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM elevated) 
        / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM all_tested), 2
    ) AS pct_clearly_elevated
;

I'm preparing a department audit on how often anti-ribonuclear protein testing comes back clearly elevated among the women in the thrombosis cohort. Among the women in the cohort, what percentage of those with an available anti-ribonuclear protein test result had a clearly elevated result? Please give me the percentage rounded to two decimal places on the 0-100 scale. Note: elevated means a titer strictly above 1:64. Patients never tested for anti-ribonuclear protein should be excluded from both the numerator and the denominator, while a negative reading counts as an available result and is never elevated.

No follow-up user is available. Give the best supported answer for the question. Return your final answer as exactly one fenced SQL block containing a single read-only SQLite SELECT/WITH query. Exclude intermediate SQL.

calls.content:
```sql
WITH thrombosis_women AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.patient_id
    FROM Patient p
    WHERE p.gender = 'Female' AND p.cohort = 'thrombosis'
),
an_rnp_results AS (
    SELECT
        l.patient_id,
        l.titer_value
    FROM Laboratory l
    WHERE l.test_name = 'anti-ribonuclear protein'
),
eligible_women AS (
    SELECT t.patient_id, a.titer_value
    FROM thrombosis_women t
    JOIN an_rnp_results a ON t.patient_id = a.patient_id
),
results_categorized AS (
    SELECT
        patient_id,
        titer_value,
        -- Assuming stored as "1:XX" or integer; strip prefix if needed and compare numerically
        CASE
            WHEN instr(titer_value, ':') > 0
                THEN CAST(substr(titer_value, instr(titer_value, ':') + 1) AS INTEGER)
            ELSE CAST(titer_value AS INTEGER)
        END AS titer_numeric
    FROM eligible_women
)
SELECT
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN titer_numeric > 64 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*)
    , 2) AS pct_clearly_elevated
FROM results_categorized;
```

WITH qualified_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    l.ID AS PatientID
  FROM Laboratory l
  WHERE
    -- Grade 3 or 4 (original scale)
    (l."U-PRO" IN ('3', '4'))

    OR (l."U-PRO" REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' AND CAST(l."U-PRO" AS INTEGER) >= 300)
),
patient_birth_years AS (
  SELECT
    p.ID AS PatientID,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS birth_year
  FROM Patient p
  WHERE p.Birthday IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  AVG(1999 - birth_year) AS avg_age_in_1999
FROM patient_birth_years pb
JOIN qualified_patients qp ON pb.PatientID = qp.PatientID
WHERE birth_year IS NOT NULL

    FROM Patient
    WHERE Diagnosis = 'psoriatic arthritis'

    LEFT JOIN Laboratory l ON pa.PatientID = l.ID

)
SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Laboratory l
        WHERE l.ID IN (SELECT PatientID FROM pa_patients)
    ) AS total_lab_tests,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lab_counts WHERE lab_test_count = 0) AS patients_with_no_lab_tests;

WITH qualifying_lab AS (
  SELECT
    l.ID AS LabPatientID
  FROM Laboratory l
  WHERE 
    l.LDH > 600 AND l.LDH < 800
    AND (
      -- U-PRO: proteinuria, accept values like '300', '≥300', 'at least 300', etc.
      CAST(
        CASE
          WHEN l.[U-PRO] GLOB '*[0-9]*' THEN 
            REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(l.[U-PRO], '≥', ''), 'at least ', ''), ' ', '')
          ELSE NULL
        END AS INTEGER
      ) >= 300
    )
  GROUP BY l.ID, l.Date
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  p.ID AS PatientID,
  CAST((strftime('%Y', '2026-10-09') - strftime('%Y', p.Birthday)) - (strftime('%m-%d', '2026-10-09') < strftime('%m-%d', p.Birthday)) AS INTEGER) AS Age_As_of_2026_10_09
FROM qualifying_lab ql
JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = ql.LabPatientID
ORDER BY p.ID
LIMIT 1000

WITH cho_labs AS (
  SELECT
    p.ID AS PatientID,
    l.[T-CHO] AS T_CHO,

  JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID

  ON c.AdmissionStatus = m.AdmissionStatus AND c.T_CHO = m.max_t_cho
ORDER BY
  CASE c.AdmissionStatus WHEN '+' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,

WITH sle_patients AS (
  SELECT ID AS patient_id
  FROM Patient
  WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'
),
only_sle_patients AS (
  SELECT p.patient_id
  FROM sle_patients p
  LEFT JOIN Patient other_diag
    ON p.patient_id = other_diag.ID
    AND other_diag.Diagnosis <> 'SLE'
  WHERE other_diag.ID IS NULL
),
abnormal_proteinuria_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID AS patient_id
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE U-PRO IS NOT NULL AND U-PRO <> '' AND (
    U-PRO LIKE '%high%' OR
    U-PRO LIKE '%abnormal%' OR
    U-PRO LIKE '%3+' OR U-PRO LIKE '%4+' -- common patterns for abnormal proteinuria
  )
),
target_patients AS (
  SELECT patient_id
  FROM only_sle_patients
  INTERSECT
  SELECT patient_id
  FROM abnormal_proteinuria_patients
),
care_setting_summary AS (
  SELECT
    p.Admission,
    t.patient_id
  FROM Patient p
  JOIN target_patients t ON p.ID = t.patient_id
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN Admission = '입원' OR Admission = 'admitted' OR Admission = 'inpatient' THEN 'admitted'
    WHEN Admission = '외래' OR Admission = 'outpatient' THEN 'outpatient'
    ELSE 'other'
  END AS care_setting,
  COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) AS patient_count
FROM care_setting_summary
WHERE Admission IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY care_setting
HAVING care_setting IN ('admitted', 'outpatient');

I'm reviewing patients with an elevated anti-ribonuclear protein result. Among patients who ever had an anti-ribonuclear protein result of 16 or higher, I want to follow up the three whose liver enzymes stayed in the normal range. The normal range for GPT is below 60. For each patient, take their highest GPT value among their laboratory tests that fall in the normal range. Rank patients from that highest value down; if two patients share the same value, the one with the smaller patient ID comes first. Please return exactly three patients, one row per patient, with only each patient's Birthday.

No follow-up user is available. Give the best supported answer for the question. Return your final answer as exactly one fenced SQL block containing a single read-only SQLite SELECT/WITH query. Exclude intermediate SQL.

calls.content:
```sql
WITH Elevated_ANTI_RNP_Patients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT Patient_ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE Test_Name = 'Anti-Ribonuclear Protein' AND Result_Value >= 16
),
Normal_GPT_Results AS (
    SELECT l.Patient_ID, l.Result_Value AS GPT_Value
    FROM Laboratory l
    WHERE l.Test_Name = 'GPT' AND l.Result_Value < 60
      AND l.Patient_ID IN (SELECT Patient_ID FROM Elevated_ANTI_RNP_Patients)
),
All_GPT_Results AS (
    SELECT l.Patient_ID, MAX(l.Result_Value) AS Max_GPT
    FROM Laboratory l
    WHERE l.Test_Name = 'GPT'
      AND l.Patient_ID IN (SELECT Patient_ID FROM Elevated_ANTI_RNP_Patients)
    GROUP BY l.Patient_ID
),
Patients_Always_Normal_GPT AS (
    SELECT ngr.Patient_ID
    FROM Elevated_ANTI_RNP_Patients eap
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT Patient_ID
        FROM Laboratory
        WHERE Test_Name = 'GPT' AND Result_Value >= 60
    ) abnormal ON eap.Patient_ID = abnormal.Patient_ID
    WHERE abnormal.Patient_ID IS NULL
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM Normal_GPT_Results n WHERE n.Patient_ID = eap.Patient_ID
      )
)
SELECT p.Birthday
FROM Patients_Always_Normal_GPT pan
JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = pan.Patient_ID
JOIN (
    SELECT Patient_ID, MAX(GPT_Value) AS Highest_Normal_GPT
    FROM Normal_GPT_Results
    GROUP BY Patient_ID
) hnq ON hnq.Patient_ID = pan.Patient_ID
ORDER BY hnq.Highest_Normal_GPT DESC, pan.Patient_ID ASC
LIMIT 3
```

    SELECT DISTINCT ID AS Patient_ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE CAST(RNP AS FLOAT) >= 16

Normal_GPTs AS (

    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE GPT IS NOT NULL AND GPT < 60
      AND ID IN (SELECT Patient_ID FROM Elevated_RNP_Patients)
),
Abnormal_GPTs AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID AS Patient_ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE GPT >= 60
      AND ID IN (SELECT Patient_ID FROM Elevated_RNP_Patients)
),
Patients_Always_Normal_GPT AS (
    SELECT Patient_ID
    FROM Elevated_RNP_Patients
    WHERE Patient_ID NOT IN (SELECT Patient_ID FROM Abnormal_GPTs)
      AND Patient_ID IN (SELECT Patient_ID FROM Normal_GPTs)
),
Best_Normal_GPT AS (
    SELECT Patient_ID, MAX(GPT) AS Highest_Normal_GPT
    FROM Normal_GPTs
    WHERE Patient_ID IN (SELECT Patient_ID FROM Patients_Always_Normal_GPT)
    GROUP BY Patient_ID
)
SELECT p.Birthday
FROM Best_Normal_GPT bng
JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = bng.Patient_ID
ORDER BY bng.Highest_Normal_GPT DESC, bng.Patient_ID ASC
LIMIT 3;

            WHEN p.Admission = '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital'

    FROM Patient p

),
anti_rnp_flag AS (
    SELECT
        l.ID AS patient_id,
        MAX(CASE
            WHEN
                l.RNP IS NOT NULL

    FROM Laboratory l

    SELECT

    SUM(CASE WHEN has_elevated = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS patients_with_elevated_result,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_elevated = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS patients_without_elevated_result
FROM joined

```sql
SELECT
```
  a.PatientID,
  a.Diagnosis,
  a.AntiDNATestResult
FROM anti_dna_results a
JOIN max_result m
  ON CAST(a.AntiDNATestResult AS FLOAT) = m.MaxAntiDNATestResult
WHERE a.AntiDNATestResult GLOB '*[0-9]*'

WITH care_settings AS (
  SELECT
    ID AS PatientID,
    CASE
      WHEN Admission = 'hospital' THEN 'admitted to the hospital'
      WHEN Admission = 'outpatient' THEN 'followed at the outpatient clinic'
      ELSE NULL
    END AS care_label
  FROM Patient
  WHERE Admission IN ('hospital', 'outpatient')
),
latest_igg AS (
  SELECT
    l.ID AS LabID,
    l.IGG,
    l.Date,
    l.ID AS PatientID
  FROM Laboratory l
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT
      ID AS PatientID,
      MAX(Date) AS max_date
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE IGG IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ID
  ) mlab
    ON l.ID = mlab.PatientID AND l.Date = mlab.max_date
),
patients_with_results AS (
  SELECT
    c.PatientID,
    c.care_label,
    li.IGG
  FROM care_settings c
  LEFT JOIN latest_igg li
    ON c.PatientID = li.PatientID
)
SELECT
  care_label AS "Care Setting",
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN IGG BETWEEN 700 AND 1600 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS "percentage_with_normal_IgG"
FROM patients_with_results
GROUP BY care_label
ORDER BY care_label

For our thrombosis study cohort, I'd like to know how often patients have a normal IgG status at their most recent check, broken down by care setting. Please give me, for patients admitted to the hospital and for patients followed at the outpatient clinic, the percentage of that setting's patients whose most recent IgG measurement was normal. The percentage should be out of every patient in that setting, so patients who never had an IgG measurement count toward the denominator but not the numerator. Please round to one decimal place, and label the two results exactly as 'admitted to the hospital' and 'followed at the outpatient clinic'.

No follow-up user is available. Give the best supported answer for the question. Return your final answer as exactly one fenced SQL block containing a single read-only SQLite SELECT/WITH query. Exclude intermediate SQL.

calls.content:
```sql
WITH latest_igg AS (
  SELECT
    p.PatientID,
    p.CareSetting,
    l.ResultNumeric AS IgG_Value,
    l.Result AS IgG_Result,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.PatientID ORDER BY l.CollectionDate DESC) AS rn
  FROM Patient p
  LEFT JOIN Laboratory l
    ON p.PatientID = l.PatientID AND l.TestName = 'IgG'
  WHERE p.CareSetting IN ('admitted to the hospital', 'followed at the outpatient clinic')
),
most_recent_igg AS (
  SELECT
    PatientID,
    CareSetting,
    IgG_Value,
    IgG_Result
  FROM latest_igg
  WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
  cs.CareSetting,
  ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE 
               WHEN m.IgG_Result = 'Normal' THEN 1
               ELSE 0
             END) AS FLOAT) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1) AS percentage_with_normal_IgG
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT PatientID, CareSetting
  FROM Patient
  WHERE CareSetting IN ('admitted to the hospital', 'followed at the outpatient clinic')
) cs
LEFT JOIN most_recent_igg m
  ON cs.PatientID = m.PatientID
GROUP BY cs.CareSetting
ORDER BY cs.CareSetting
```

Please give me a single integer: the number of female patients whose most recent visit shows a strongly positive anti-RNP result, minus the number of male patients whose most recent visit shows such a result. WITH LatestVisits AS (
```sql
  SELECT 
    l.PatientId,
    l.VisitDate,
    l.Level,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY l.PatientId ORDER BY l.VisitDate DESC) AS rn
  FROM Laboratory l
  WHERE l.TestName = 'anti-RNP'
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.Sex = 'F' AND lv.Level >= 32 AND lv.rn = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0)

JOIN Patient p ON lv.PatientId = p.PatientId
WHERE lv.rn = 1
```

```sql
  AS female_minus_male_strongly_positive
FROM LatestRNP r
JOIN Patient p ON r.PatientID = p.ID
```

WITH confirmed_sle_patients AS (
    SELECT ID AS patient_id
    FROM Patient
    WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'
),
inpatient_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.patient_id) AS num_inpatients
    FROM confirmed_sle_patients p
    JOIN Patient pt ON p.patient_id = pt.ID
    WHERE pt.Admission = 'inpatient'
),
outpatient_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.patient_id) AS num_outpatients
    FROM confirmed_sle_patients p
    JOIN Patient pt ON p.patient_id = pt.ID
    WHERE pt.Admission = 'outpatient'
),
totals AS (
    SELECT 
        ic.num_inpatients,
        oc.num_outpatients,
        (ic.num_inpatients + oc.num_outpatients) AS total_in_either_setting
    FROM inpatient_count ic
    CROSS JOIN outpatient_count oc
)
SELECT
    num_inpatients,
    num_outpatients,
    ROUND(
      CASE WHEN total_in_either_setting = 0 THEN 0.0
           ELSE CAST(num_inpatients AS FLOAT) * 100.0 / total_in_either_setting
      END, 2
    ) AS inpatient_percentage
FROM totals;

sql:
WITH sle_examinations AS (
  SELECT
    e.ID AS ExaminationID,
    e."Examination Date",
    e.Symptoms,
    e.Diagnosis AS ExaminationDiagnosis,
    e."ID" AS ExaminationPatientID
  FROM Examination e
  WHERE e.Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%'
    AND e.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(e.Symptoms) != ''
),
eligible_patients AS (
  SELECT
    p.ID AS PatientID,
    p.Birthday,
    p.Diagnosis AS PatientDiagnosis
  FROM Patient p
  JOIN sle_examinations se ON p.ID = se.ExaminationPatientID
),
youngest_patient AS (
  SELECT
    ep.PatientID,
    ep.Birthday,
    ep.PatientDiagnosis
  FROM eligible_patients ep
  WHERE ep.Birthday = (
    SELECT MIN(Birthday) FROM eligible_patients
  )
  ORDER BY ep.PatientID ASC
  LIMIT 1
),
most_recent_sle_exam AS (
  SELECT
    se.Symptoms,
    yp.PatientDiagnosis
  FROM sle_examinations se
  JOIN youngest_patient yp ON se.ExaminationPatientID = yp.PatientID
  WHERE se."Examination Date" = (
    SELECT MAX("Examination Date")
    FROM sle_examinations
    WHERE ExaminationPatientID = yp.PatientID
  )
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  Symptoms AS SymptomAtExamination,
  PatientDiagnosis AS OverallDiagnosis
FROM most_recent_sle_exam;

I'm reviewing confirmed SLE cases for a study of neurologic involvement. Among patients whose examination lists SLE among the diagnosed diseases and who have a symptom recorded at such an examination, I need the case detail of the youngest such patient. Please send me the symptom recorded at that qualifying examination and that patient's overall diagnosis (their overall diagnosis, not the diagnosis written at the examination). If two patients share the same birth date, use the one with the smaller patient ID; and if that patient has more than one qualifying examination, use the most recent one.

No follow-up user is available. Give the best supported answer for the question. Return your final answer as exactly one fenced SQL block containing a single read-only SQLite SELECT/WITH query. Exclude intermediate SQL.

calls.content:
```sql
WITH sle_examinations AS (
  SELECT
    e.ExaminationID,
    e.PatientID,
    e.Date AS ExaminationDate,
    e.Symptom,
    e.DiagnosedDiseases
  FROM Examination e
  WHERE e.DiagnosedDiseases LIKE '%SLE%'
    AND e.Symptom IS NOT NULL
    AND e.Symptom != ''
),
youngest_patients AS (
  SELECT
    se.PatientID,
    p.BirthDate
  FROM sle_examinations se
  JOIN Patient p ON se.PatientID = p.PatientID
  GROUP BY se.PatientID
),
min_birthdate_patient AS (
  SELECT
    yp.PatientID,
    yp.BirthDate
  FROM youngest_patients yp
  WHERE yp.BirthDate = (SELECT MIN(BirthDate) FROM youngest_patients)
  ORDER BY yp.PatientID ASC
  LIMIT 1
),
most_recent_exam AS (
  SELECT
    se.*
  FROM sle_examinations se
  JOIN min_birthdate_patient mbp ON se.PatientID = mbp.PatientID
  WHERE se.ExaminationDate = (
    SELECT MAX(ExaminationDate)
    FROM sle_examinations
    WHERE PatientID = mbp.PatientID
  )
  ORDER BY se.ExaminationDate DESC, se.ExaminationID DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  mre.Symptom AS SymptomAtExamination,
  p.OverallDiagnosis
FROM most_recent_exam mre
JOIN Patient p ON mre.PatientID = p.PatientID;
```

I'm auditing inpatient intake during the February 1998 admission wave. Among patients first seen at the hospital in the second half of February 1998 (visit date from 15 to 28 February 1998), find the oldest inpatient at first presentation and give me that patient's diagnosis only. If two patients tie in age, use the one with the smaller patient ID.

No follow-up user is available. Give the best supported answer for the question. Return your final answer as exactly one fenced SQL block containing a single read-only SQLite SELECT/WITH query. Exclude intermediate SQL.

calls.content:
```sql
WITH FirstAdmissions AS (
    SELECT
        Patient.Patient_ID,
        Patient.Date_of_Birth,
        Examination.Visit_Date,
        Examination.Diagnosis,
        Examination.Admission_Type
    FROM
        Patient
    JOIN
        Examination ON Patient.Patient_ID = Examination.Patient_ID
    WHERE
        DATE(Examination.Visit_Date) BETWEEN '1998-02-15' AND '1998-02-28'
    -- Only admissions where the first-ever visit date matches the current visit, and is in the window
        AND Examination.Visit_Date = (
            SELECT MIN(Examination2.Visit_Date)
            FROM Examination Examination2
            WHERE Examination2.Patient_ID = Patient.Patient_ID
        )
        AND Examination.Admission_Type = 'inpatient'
)
SELECT
    Diagnosis
FROM
    FirstAdmissions
ORDER BY
    -- compute oldest: max age = earliest dob
    Date_of_Birth ASC,
    Patient_ID ASC
LIMIT 1;
```

sql:
WITH low_rbc_patients AS ( 
  SELECT DISTINCT ID AS PatientId 
  FROM Laboratory 
  WHERE RBC < 3.5
),
admission_status AS (
  SELECT
    p.ID AS PatientId,
    CASE
      WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM Examination e
        WHERE e.ID = p.ID AND e.[Diagnosis] LIKE '%입원%'
      ) THEN '+'
      ELSE '-'
    END AS CareSetting
  FROM Patient p
  WHERE p.ID IN (SELECT PatientId FROM low_rbc_patients)
),
ages AS (
  SELECT
    p.ID AS PatientId,
    CAST((strftime('%Y', '2026-10-09') - strftime('%Y', p.Birthday)) -
      (strftime('%m-%d', '2026-10-09') < strftime('%m-%d', p.Birthday)) AS INTEGER) AS Age
  FROM Patient p
  WHERE p.ID IN (SELECT PatientId FROM low_rbc_patients)
)
SELECT
  a.CareSetting,
  COUNT(*) AS PatientCount,
  ROUND(AVG(ag.Age * 1.0), 1) AS AvgCompletedAge
FROM admission_status a
JOIN ages ag ON a.PatientId = ag.PatientId
GROUP BY a.CareSetting

WITH mol_with_single_bond AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
  FROM bond
  WHERE bond_type = 'single'
),
molecule_oxygen_counts AS (
  SELECT
    m.molecule_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'O' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS oxygen_count
  FROM molecule m
  LEFT JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
  GROUP BY m.molecule_id
)
SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(moc.oxygen_count * 1.0), 4) AS avg_oxygen_atoms_per_molecule
FROM mol_with_single_bond msb
JOIN molecule_oxygen_counts moc ON msb.molecule_id = moc.molecule_id;

WITH single_bond_molecules AS (
  SELECT m.molecule_id
  FROM molecule m
  LEFT JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
  GROUP BY m.molecule_id

  FROM molecule m
)
SELECT
  saturation_group,
  SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS carcinogenic_minus_noncarcinogenic
FROM molecule_labels
GROUP BY saturation_group

sql:
WITH molecule_atoms AS (
    SELECT
        m.molecule_id AS molecule_id,
        m.label AS carcinogenicity_label,
        COUNT(a.atom_id) AS atom_count,
        SUM(a.element = 'C') AS carbon_count,
        SUM(a.element = 'Cl') AS chlorine_count
    FROM molecule m
    LEFT JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
    GROUP BY m.molecule_id
),
bond_atoms AS (
    SELECT
        b.bond_id,
        b.molecule_id,
        b.bond_type,
        MIN(a.atom_id) AS atom1_id,
        MAX(a.atom_id) AS atom2_id
    FROM bond b
    JOIN atom a ON b.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
    GROUP BY b.bond_id, b.molecule_id, b.bond_type
),
carbon_bonds AS (
    SELECT
        ba.molecule_id,
        ba.bond_id,
        ba.bond_type,
        SUM(CASE WHEN a.atom_id = ba.atom1_id OR a.atom_id = ba.atom2_id THEN a.element = 'C' ELSE 0 END) AS carbon_in_bond
    FROM bond_atoms ba
    LEFT JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = ba.molecule_id
    GROUP BY ba.molecule_id, ba.bond_id, ba.bond_type
),
molecule_bonds AS (
    SELECT
        molecule_id,
        COUNT(bond_id) AS bond_count,
        SUM(bond_type IN ('double', 'triple', 'aromatic')) AS multiple_bond_count,
        SUM(carbon_in_bond > 0) AS carbon_touching_bond_count
    FROM carbon_bonds
    GROUP BY molecule_id
)
SELECT
    ma.molecule_id,
    ma.carcinogenicity_label,
    ma.atom_count,
    COALESCE(mb.bond_count, 0) AS bond_count,
    ma.carbon_count,
    ma.chlorine_count,
    COALESCE(mb.carbon_touching_bond_count, 0) AS carbon_touching_bond_count,
    COALESCE(mb.multiple_bond_count, 0) AS multiple_bond_count,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY 
            COALESCE(mb.carbon_touching_bond_count, 0) DESC,
            ma.atom_count DESC,
            ma.molecule_id ASC
    ) AS rank_position
FROM molecule_atoms ma
LEFT JOIN molecule_bonds mb ON ma.molecule_id = mb.molecule_id
WHERE ma.carbon_count > 0
ORDER BY 
    carbon_touching_bond_count DESC, 
    atom_count DESC, 
    ma.molecule_id ASC
;

For each qualifying molecule, give me its molecule id, carcinogenicity label, number of atoms, number of bonds, number of carbon atoms, number of chlorine atoms, number of carbon-touching bonds, and number of multiple bonds - one row per molecule, including molecules where some of these counts are zero. Rank the rows from the most carbon-touching bonds to the fewest; break ties by larger total atom count, then by molecule id ascending. Give consecutive rank positions 1, 2, 3, ... with no gaps after ties.

```sql
        COUNT(a.id) AS atom_count,

        SUM(a.element = 'Cl') AS chlorine_count
    FROM molecule m
    LEFT JOIN atom a ON m.id = a.molecule_id

),
atom_id_element AS (
```

    b.bond_id,
    b.molecule_id,
    b.bond_type,
    a1.element AS element1,
    a2.element AS element2
  FROM bond b
  JOIN atom a1 ON b.molecule_id = a1.molecule_id
  JOIN atom a2 ON b.molecule_id = a2.molecule_id
  WHERE a1.atom_id != a2.atom_id -- join distinct atoms
    AND b.bond_type IN ('double', 'triple')
)
SELECT 
  CASE WHEN element1 = 'C' THEN element2
       WHEN element2 = 'C' THEN element1
       ELSE NULL END AS element,
  COUNT(*) / 2 AS bond_count
FROM carbon_bonds cb
JOIN molecule m ON cb.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE (element1 = 'C' OR element2 = 'C')
  AND (element1 != 'C' OR element2 != 'C')
  AND (m.label IS NULL OR m.label NOT LIKE '%carcinogen%')
GROUP BY element
HAVING element IS NOT NULL

  SELECT molecule_id, label as carcinogenicity_label
  FROM molecule
  WHERE molecule_id = 'TR377'
),
filtered_bonds AS (
  SELECT
    b.bond_type AS bond_kind_symbol,
    COUNT(*) AS num_bonds,
    COUNT(DISTINCT
      CASE
        WHEN a1.element < a2.element THEN a1.element || '-' || a2.element
        ELSE a2.element || '-' || a1.element
      END
    ) AS num_element_pairs
  FROM bond b
  JOIN atom a1 ON b.molecule_id = a1.molecule_id AND b.bond_id LIKE a1.atom_id || '%'
  JOIN atom a2 ON b.molecule_id = a2.molecule_id AND b.bond_id LIKE '%' || a2.atom_id
  WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR377'
    AND b.bond_type IN ('single', 'double')
  GROUP BY b.bond_type
)
SELECT
  f.bond_kind_symbol,
  f.num_bonds,
  f.num_element_pairs,
  m.carcinogenicity_label
FROM filtered_bonds f
CROSS JOIN mol_info m
ORDER BY
  f.num_bonds DESC,
  f.bond_kind_symbol ASC

WITH saturated_atoms AS (
  SELECT
    a.atom_id,
    a.element
  FROM
    atom a
    JOIN bond b ON a.atom_id = b.atom1_id OR a.atom_id = b.atom2_id
  GROUP BY
    a.atom_id,
    a.element
  HAVING
    SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type != 'single' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0
    AND COUNT(*) >= 1
)
SELECT
  element AS element_symbol,
  COUNT(*) AS saturated_atom_count
FROM
  saturated_atoms
GROUP BY
  element
ORDER BY
  element_symbol ASC;

WITH triple_bond_atoms AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.element, a.molecule_id
  FROM bond b
  JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
  JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
  WHERE b.bond_type = 'triple'
)
SELECT
  element AS element_symbol,
  COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) AS molecule_count
FROM triple_bond_atoms
GROUP BY element
ORDER BY molecule_count DESC, element_symbol ASC;

```sql
WITH triple_bond_atoms AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.element, c.molecule_id
  FROM bond b
  JOIN atom a ON (b.atom1_id = a.id OR b.atom2_id = a.id)

)

FROM triple_bond_atoms
GROUP BY element
ORDER BY molecule_count DESC, element_symbol ASC;
```
